title: Four PRs that add per-document progress
subtitle: Illustrative. Each layer builds on the one below it.

prs.title: Add the run items table
prs.adds: Stores one row per document in a run, with its status

prs.title: Engine writes item progress
prs.adds: The engine records each document's status as it moves through a run

prs.title: Show progress on the runs page
prs.adds: A live progress bar for every document, synced from the new table

prs.title: Retry failed documents from the page
prs.adds: A retry button that queues only the documents that failed
prs.needs: the progress view from #103 to show which documents failed
